0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Timberwolves on the road. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota after Achilles surgery, and Keshad Johnson is out for Miami with a hamstring injury. The Timberwolves won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 122-94 win in Minnesota on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Minnesota a 50% chance to win.
